_comment: Minimal mock config for on-chain full-drain verification. Deploys a 4-validator subset (vault_nft + vault_proxy + vault_user + vusdcx) with early_withdraw_fee_bps=0 so a Deposit+full-drain cycle can complete without waiting 7 days for keeper_inactive. Does NOT exercise governance / registry / treasury / keeper_auth / order / vault_keeper_hot / vault_protocol / vault_liqwid / vault_gov_policy / vault_gov_emergency — full-drain never reads them. NOTE (2026-04-22): after the §5.4 P1 vault_core split, full-drain Withdraw lives in vault_user. The existing mock-full-drain-deploy.ts + full-drain-test.ts tools still reference vault_core and need a rewrite before re-execution — the v1-mock-drain ceremony already completed on Preprod, so this is low-priority archival maintenance.
